summary_zh: 八例原始条目、元素参考及开发标签兼容，五组成分配对无字面或声明容差内的结构重复。Bi高能成员采用peroxide修正，两个低能成员采用oxide修正；高–最低总能隙3.981423153=未修正能隙3.854566010＋修正差0.126857143eV/atom，不能把全部差异归因几何，也不能说修正完全相消。NdF3和Mg2ZnAs2配对修正差为0。氧化态图均覆盖全部元素，但不证明真实价态；磁矩与充分收敛、测量条件仍缺过程证据。
summary_en: All eight selected raw entries, elemental references and development labels agree; five composition pairs show no literal or declared-tolerance geometric duplicates. Bi has a real oxide/peroxide correction difference:3.981423153=3.854566010+0.126857143eV/atom. Corrections neither cancel nor explain the whole gap. NdF3/Mg2ZnAs2 corrections cancel. Metadata does not establish physical valence, convergence or mechanism.
bookkeeping_hypothesis_revision: Selected source labels and structures agree, excluding a mismatch within the inspected released records. Two Bi pairs have a0.126857143eV/atom oxide/peroxide correction difference; it contributes to, but does not explain, the full energy gaps. No physical mechanism or convergence conclusion is established.
